description: This file defines the Instructor API module, including interfaces and functions for retrieving dashboard stats, courses, enrollments, submission stats, quiz attempts, submissions, and assessments related to instructors.

methods.name: getInstructorDashboardStats
methods.description: Fetches dashboard statistics for an instructor, including active courses, enrolled learners, pending reviews, and learners at risk.

methods.name: getInstructorMyCourses
methods.description: Retrieves the list of courses created or owned by the instructor.

methods.name: getCourseEnrollments
methods.description: Gets the list of enrollments for a specific course.

methods.name: getCourseSubmissionStats
methods.description: Retrieves submission statistics for a specific course.

methods.name: getCourseQuizAttempts
methods.description: Fetches quiz attempt details for a specific course.

methods.name: getInstructorSubmissions
methods.description: Retrieves all quiz and assignment submissions for the instructor.

methods.name: getInstructorAssessments
methods.description: Gets the list of assessments (quizzes and assignments) for the instructor.
